newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen up ahead of settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen up ahead of settlement day.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to remain up on Monday, ahead of Tuesday's settlement day, on speculative buying after news of resumption of Pakistan-IMF talks, dealers said.

"The resumption of talks between the IMF and Pakistan is good news," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "The index had risen sharply last week and now there might be some profit-taking. But index is likely to remain up on speculative buying."
On Friday, the index rose 25.20 points or 1.53 percent to end at 1,674.04. Gainers led losers by 139 to 103.
Turnover rose to 78.31 million shares from 64.54 million in the previous session.
